description: Century Paper & Board Mills Limited manufactures and markets paper, board and related products, and is the flagship company of the Lakson Group and a market leader in packaging boards in Pakistan. Established in 1984, it runs a 162-acre plant with an annual output of about 280,000 tons and has invested in a solar plant and a Rs 250 million waste-water treatment facility.
headOffice: Lakson Square, Building No. 2, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi 74200, Pakistan
